about: Curated venue names. Each key under venues is the name shown on the site;
its list holds other wordings of the same venue. Years, edition numbers, a leading
'Proceedings of the', and text in parentheses are ignored when matching, so list each wording once.
A conference name followed by ':', ';' or ' - ' and a track or symposium counts as that conference.
workshops maps a conference to the venue that collects its co-located workshops.
With count_workshops_with_conference set to true, workshop records are shown under the conference
itself. Set it to false to show them under the workshop venue instead.
Check the result with: python -m pipeline.venues
